title: From prototype to deployment: a systematic review of real-time YOLO-based deep learning methods for railway track defect detection
title_zh: 从原型到部署：基于实时YOLO的深度学习方法在铁路轨道缺陷检测系统综述
abstract: Artificial Intelligence Review - Railway infrastructure safety relies on the timely detection of track defects, the failure of which can result in severe operational disruptions and accidents....
